source.legacy_catalog_notice: Currently unavailable for download; this conflicts with the tested NASA API endpoint, which returned the complete archive.
source.rights_conclusion: NASA's policy says NASA may not be the original source of data and users should validate source rights; no explicit license for this dataset was found. It is not treated as CC0.

task_compatibility.task: Supervised sequence-to-one remaining-useful-life regression at each cycle, with official test scoring at the final observed cycle per engine.
task_compatibility.feature_definition: Three operating settings plus 21 sensor values; engine ID and cycle index are excluded from the feature vector.
task_compatibility.target: Training RUL is derived from final train cycle minus current cycle and clipped at the conventional cap of 125; official test final-cycle labels come from the supplied per-engine RUL file. Earlier test-cycle labels can be derived from the final label and cycle distance only for a separately specified task.
task_compatibility.split: For each subset, sort training engine IDs and hold out the final 20% of engines for validation; retain the official per-engine test set. Never split overlapping windows across engines or partitions.

difficulty.source_characteristics: Four simulation regimes differ in operating-condition count (one vs six) and fault-mode count (one vs two); the source describes sensor noise and progressive degradation.
difficulty.reason: Reuse license is unspecified, so the dataset fails the open-license admission gate before training.
difficulty.non_saturation: Not empirically established; source complexity alone is insufficient evidence.

disposition.suite_result: Cross out C-MAPSS for this open-license benchmark suite. Task architecture, public anonymous download, parsed data, and estimated full-batch scale pass; rights and empirical difficulty gates do not.

evidence_boundary: The complete artifact was downloaded and parsed in this audit. No train, validation, or test model run was performed, and no claim is made that C-MAPSS would or would not saturate a plain MLP.
